audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for cleansing holiness, open heart, Macedonia pressure, Titus comfort, grief according to Divine, earnestness and restoration.

verses.restored: Therefore, having these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of flesh and spirit, completing holiness in reverence/fear of the Divine.

familiar.text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

verses.restored: Make room for us. We wronged no one, corrupted no one, exploited no one.

familiar.text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

verses.restored: I do not say this for condemnation; for I have said before that you are in our hearts, to die together and live together.

familiar.text: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

verses.restored: Great is my boldness toward you; great is my boasting on your behalf. I have been filled with comfort/encouragement; I overflow with joy in all our pressure.

familiar.text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

verses.restored: For even when we came into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were pressured in every way: outside conflicts, inside fears.

familiar.text: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

verses.restored: But the Divine, the One comforting/encouraging the lowly, comforted/encouraged us by the arrival of Titus,

familiar.text: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

verses.restored: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort/encouragement with which he was comforted/encouraged among you, reporting to us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced even more.

familiar.text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

verses.restored: For even if I grieved you by the letter, I do not regret it; even if I did regret, for I see that the letter grieved you, though only for an hour,

familiar.text: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

verses.restored: now I rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved into turning/realignment; for you were grieved according to the Divine, so that in nothing you might suffer loss from us.

familiar.text: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

verses.restored: For grief according to the Divine works turning/realignment into salvation/healing without regret; but the grief of the world works death.

familiar.text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

verses.restored: For look at this very thing, that you were grieved according to the Divine: what earnestness it worked in you, but also defense, indignation, fear/reverence, longing, zeal, correction. In everything you showed yourselves to be pure in the matter.

familiar.text: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

verses.restored: So then, if I also wrote to you, it was not because of the one doing wrong, nor because of the one wronged, but so that your earnestness for us might be made manifest to you before the Divine.

familiar.text: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

verses.restored: Because of this we have been comforted/encouraged. And besides our comfort/encouragement, we rejoiced much more abundantly over the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

familiar.text: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

verses.restored: For if I have boasted anything to him about you, I was not put to shame; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, so also our boasting before Titus became truth.

familiar.text: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

verses.restored: And his inward affections are more abundantly toward you, remembering the obedience of you all, how with fear/reverence and trembling you received him.

familiar.text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

verses.restored: I rejoice that in everything I am courageous/confident in you.

familiar.text: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

translation_notes: Grief according to the Divine is transformative grief that leads to turning and life, not shame-collapse.
Paul distinguishes restorative grief from worldly grief that works death.
